Intake_Module.title: Intake
Intake_Module.why_this_matters: The template is fed a drafted specification, not a blank form. If the input is misread, every downstream module elaborates the wrong intent with full confidence. Intake is where that is caught, and it is the only module with no fallback.

Context_Module.title: Context
Context_Module.why_this_matters: Context determines how ambiguity is interpreted. Without an explicit role, domain, and audience, the model guesses, and guesses compound across sections.

Instruction_Module.title: Instruction
Instruction_Module.why_this_matters: Reasoning scaffolding does not just improve quality, it changes what output is possible. This module carries the construction cycle, the critique loop, and the prohibitions.

Requirements_Module.title: Requirements
Requirements_Module.why_this_matters: EARS is the mechanism that makes requirements observable and falsifiable. A specification whose functional logic is not pattern-constrained readmits the ambiguity this template exists to remove.

Verification_Module.title: Verification
Verification_Module.why_this_matters: A specification that has not been checked for contradictions and coverage gaps is a draft. Refinement repairs the language layer, auto-formalization checks the logical layer, and health metrics keep the specification and the code from drifting apart.

Output_Contract_Module.title: Output Contract
Output_Contract_Module.why_this_matters: Format determines whether the consumer can parse and act on the content. The contract fixes the prompt anatomy, the Specification Stack, and the quality bar the critique loop scores against.

dependency_map.why_this_matters: Loading modules the task does not need wastes context and degrades output. File references are just-in-time context loading; include only what the route requires.

complexity_routing.procedure: Evaluate every trigger below against the Intake classification, in order, and record each as fired or not fired with the input line that decides it. Route Complex if any trigger fired. Otherwise route Simple if the simple_condition holds, and Standard in every other case. Carry the full evaluation into the Process Summary of the critique artifact.
complexity_routing.trigger: The input names a regulation, standard, regulator, audit obligation, or compliance regime, or the system handles personal, financial, health, or safety data. This is the same condition as the Regulated Industry domain signal.
Two or more domain_signals apply to the intended final state.

The input marks a rule as holding regardless of mode, state, or actor, with an explicit marker such as absolute, non-negotiable, guaranteed, in every mode, under no circumstances, or always or never applied to the system as a whole. Only the marker fires this trigger. A feature statement in the form "X are rejected" or "the system does Y" describes triggered behaviour and does not fire T3. The absence of a marker is a determination, not a doubt, so the tie_break does not convert an unmarked feature into an invariant. An invariant is what the consistency check exists to protect.
The system makes payments, files with an authority, transmits to a third party, deletes or purges user data, or actuates physical equipment.
The input asks for proofs, invariants, formal properties, or machine-checkable requirements.
complexity_routing.simple_condition: The intended final state is a document or content artifact rather than a system whose behaviour must be specified, so no EARS requirement will be written.
complexity_routing.tie_break: If it is unclear whether a trigger fires, it fires. The Verification module costs a few dozen lines of context; a missed contradiction costs a shipped defect.

route.rule: no trigger fired and the simple_condition holds

complexity_routing.route: Fallback variants of Context and Output Contract are acceptable on this route.

route.rule: no trigger fired and the simple_condition does not hold

complexity_routing.route: A full EARS requirement set constructed through the critique cycle, without auto-formalization.
Auto-formalization, formal-methods vocabulary, the full pipeline.

dependency_map.rule_of_thumb: If the loaded template exceeds 15 percent of the model context window, trim optional modules first.
